scenes.audio: This man you're seeing isn't a human, he's a monster, a monster! His stomach is a volcano, let me tell you how.
scenes.label: Opening Hook
scenes.visual: A young man, around 18-22 years old, with light brown skin, curly dark brown hair, wearing a white and black t-shirt, is speaking directly to the camera with an expressive face. He gestures with his hands to emphasize his words. Behind him, a blurred room with some lighting can be seen. He presents an image of an older man with white hair and beard, wearing a black suit and holding a glass of wine, in front of a small airplane.

scenes.label: Product Information
scenes.visual: A middle-aged man with dark hair, wearing a green patterned shirt, is looking down and touching his chin. He has a mole on his chin.

scenes.audio: In his childhood, he accidentally ate glass, and after eating glass, he actually enjoyed it.
scenes.label: Product Information
scenes.visual: A young boy, around 10-12 years old, with dark hair, is sitting at a table and eating something from a bowl with a spoon. He has a surprised expression on his face.

scenes.audio: Then he realized that he could eat anything, anything!
scenes.label: Product Information
scenes.visual: An animated character of a young man with blonde hair and blue eyes, wearing a striped shirt and blue overalls, is making a funny face and then running away.

scenes.audio: So then he tried eating a little bit of iron too.
scenes.label: Product Information
scenes.visual: A close-up of a hand picking up small pieces of metal from a plate with green vegetables.

scenes.audio: That also got digested in his body.
scenes.label: Product Information
scenes.visual: The same middle-aged man from scene 2 is seen again, chewing something.

scenes.audio: When doctors investigated, they found out that he has a rare condition called Pica.
scenes.label: Product Information
scenes.visual: The same middle-aged man is lying on an examination table in a doctor's office, while a doctor in a white coat is examining his stomach with an ultrasound machine.

scenes.audio: It means his stomach is much thicker than a normal person's and his stomach acids are also much stronger, which can digest anything.
scenes.label: Product Information
scenes.visual: An anatomical illustration of a stomach and intestines, showing the digestive process. Then, another illustration of a stomach with a thick lining and strong acids.

scenes.audio: Then what? Brother, bulbs, blades, glass, screws, he would eat them while walking around!
scenes.label: Product Information
scenes.visual: The young man from scene 1 is back, speaking excitedly and gesturing with his hands.

scenes.audio: In his lifetime, he ate 18 bicycles...
scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.visual: The middle-aged man is shown working on a bicycle wheel, possibly taking it apart.

scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.visual: A clean, modern bedroom with a white bed, some plants, and a window with curtains.

scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.visual: A large, ornate chandelier hanging from a ceiling.

scenes.audio: ...seven TVs, and then he thought, 'No man, this is not fun, why not eat an airplane? It will be fun!'
scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.visual: The young man from scene 1 is back, looking thoughtful and scratching his head.

scenes.audio: Brother, he ate the whole airplane bit by bit.
scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.visual: The older man from the image in scene 1 is sitting at a table with a white tablecloth in front of an airplane. He is holding a piece of metal and a fork and knife.

scenes.audio: In two years, he finished the whole plane.
scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.visual: An animation of an airplane being dismantled and its parts flying towards the camera.

scenes.audio: When the Guinness Book of World Records people gave him a certificate and a trophy for eating the strangest things...
scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.visual: A person holding a Guinness Book of World Records. Then, a shot of the middle-aged man eating a piece of glass. Finally, an animation of a man holding a trophy.

scenes.audio: ...he ate that too! Brother! Then they made a new award for him on which was written, 'Brother, please don't eat this!'
scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.visual: The young man from scene 1 is back, looking shocked and then folding his hands in a prayer-like gesture.
